Journalist Alex Cosh challenged Canadian Justice Minister Sean Fraser on how Canada can claim to support the International Criminal Court while allowing Netanyahu to fly through its airspace. Fraser said the ICC arrest warrant applies only if Netanyahu lands on Canadian soil. Netanyahu crossed Canadian airspace on September 24, 2026, on his way to address the UN in New York, according to flight-tracking data reported by the Canadian Press.
